english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday description of someone who does not give up easily.
Use this for someone who keeps trying and does not give up, usually with a positive tone.

examples.english: They practise running every day and do not stop even when it rains; they are really tenacious.
examples.traditional: 佢日日練跑，就算落雨都唔停，真係好有毅力。

examples.english: They are persistent and practise running every day, eventually finishing a marathon.
examples.traditional: 佢好有毅力，日日練跑，終於跑完馬拉松。
